transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I feel like God’s picked me out personally to fix everything in this town, and nobody understands how important my mission is. People at my work and even my wife are trying to hold me back, but they just don't see what I've been chosen to do.
Have you ever had a period like this before, especially one with very high energy, little need for sleep, racing thoughts, or feeling unusually euphoric or irritable?

No, I’ve never had a period like this before in my life. It only started about a year and a half ago, a month or two after my workload at the agency got really heavy. Since then, I've been in this revved-up, high-energy mode for most of the past year.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things others could not, or had any other unusual experiences besides this belief that you were chosen for a special mission?

Yes, I often hear this deep, calm voice that isn't mine telling me what to do, like which client to visit first or when to pray over someone. I also hear people at church whispering my name and saying I'm chosen, even when they swear up and down they never said a word.
Have these beliefs and voices been present continuously for at least 3 months, or did they come on suddenly and last less than 3 months?

They've been going on for way longer than three months. It's been happening steadily for most of this past year, gradually building up ever since I took on that extra workload about a year and a half ago. It definitely wasn't some sudden thing that just came and went.

During this time, have you also had clear mood symptoms like feeling abnormally elevated or irritable, needing much less sleep, talking much more than usual, or having racing thoughts? Or has it mostly been the fixed beliefs and voices without those mood changes?

I definitely get both. When I'm super revved up on just three hours of sleep with my mind racing, that deep voice is right there telling me what to do. But even during times when my energy drops and I feel more 'blah' or flat, I still hear the voice and know I'm being watched and guided.
Have there been any periods of at least 2 weeks when you still had the voices or fixed beliefs, but you were not having the high-energy, little-sleep, racing-thoughts state at all?

Yes, there have been stretches of several weeks where I felt really low-key and 'blah' instead of fired up. Even during those quiet times, I still heard that calm voice giving me instructions and knew the county and my bosses were tracking me as God's protector.

Have you ever had a clear manic or hypomanic episode that lasted at least several days, with unusually elevated or irritable mood, much less sleep, more talkative behavior, and increased activity beyond your usual self?

Yes, I've had those periods last way longer than just several days—it's been my main state for most of this past year. I get so revved up on only three or four hours of sleep that I'm constantly on the move cleaning or planning, and I'll snap at anyone who tries to slow me down. It feels like I'm just full of electricity and have to keep going.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least 2 weeks when the voices or fixed beliefs were completely gone, even if your mood was still low or high?

No, those voices and beliefs haven't gone away for any stretch of time. Even when I'm feeling completely flat or 'blah' instead of fired up, I still hear that calm voice and know I'm being watched and tracked as God's protector. It's been going on steadily like that for most of this past year.
Have you ever had any long period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or fixed beliefs were completely gone, even if your mood was still high or low?

No, those voices and beliefs have never gone away, not even for a two-week stretch. They've been pretty steady and constant for most of this past year, even during the times when my mood was completely flat or low-key instead of fired up.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or fixed beliefs were still present, but you were not having any clear manic symptoms like decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, or feeling unusually energized or irritable?

Yes, there have been stretches of several weeks where I didn't have that high energy or racing mind and just felt 'blah' and flat. Even during those times, I still heard that calm voice giving me instructions and knew the county and my bosses were tracking me.

Have you ever had a time when your mood was clearly high or irritable with much less sleep and racing thoughts for at least 1 week, while the voices or fixed beliefs were still there the whole time? Or have the voices and beliefs also continued for at least 2 weeks when your mood was not high or irritable?

Yes, I've had both of those things happen. When I'm buzzing with energy on almost no sleep and trying to overhaul everything, I hear that deep voice and the whispering at the exact same time. But I've also had stretches of several weeks where my mood was completely flat and 'blah,' and I still heard the voice and knew the county was tracking me.
Have you had any major changes in your work, relationships, or self-care because of these symptoms, and did those problems happen only during the high-energy periods or even when your mood was flat?

Yes, my boss put me on probation and cut my hours for missed charting, my pastor made me step back from leadership, and my wife is upset because I'm not helping with the kids or bills. These problems happen during both times, because even when my mood is flat and 'blah', I'm still distracted by that voice and knowing the county is tracking me. It doesn't just stop when my energy drops.
Have you ever had at least 2 weeks when the voices and fixed beliefs were completely gone, even if your mood was still high or low?

No, those voices and beliefs have never gone away, not even for a two-week stretch. They've been pretty steady and constant for most of this past year, even during the times when my mood was completely flat or low-key instead of fired up.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when your mood was clearly normal or only mildly off, but the voices or fixed beliefs were still there?

Yes, I have. There have been stretches of several weeks where my mood was completely normal or just a bit flat, but I still heard that calm voice giving me instructions. Even during those quiet times, I remained absolutely certain that the county and my bosses were tracking me as God's special protector.
Have you ever had any periods of depression, such as feeling very sad, losing interest, low energy, or hopelessness, that lasted at least 2 weeks while the voices or fixed beliefs were still present?

I don't really experience deep sadness or hopelessness, but I definitely have times where I feel completely flat, empty, and "blah"—losing all interest in things I love like hunting, dancing, or playing with my kids. Even during these flat, low-key periods which can last for weeks at a time, I still hear that calm guiding voice and remain convinced that I am being watched and tracked as God's special protector.

Have you ever had a true major depressive episode lasting at least 2 weeks, with depressed mood or loss of interest plus symptoms like sleep or appetite changes, guilt, low energy, or thoughts of death?
No, I haven't really ever experienced a deep depression like that. I've only had those times where I feel 'flat' or 'blah' and lose interest in things, rather than a full depressive episode.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or fixed beliefs were completely gone, even if your mood was still high or low?

No, the voices and beliefs have never gone away for a period like that. They have been pretty steady and constant for most of this past year, even during the times when my mood shifted to feeling more flat or low-key.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when your mood was clearly normal or only mildly off, but the voices or fixed beliefs were still there?

Yes, I have. There have been stretches of several weeks where my mood felt pretty normal or just a bit flat, but I still heard that calm voice guiding me. Even during those times when I wasn't fired up at all, I was still completely sure the county and my bosses were tracking me as God's protector.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or fixed beliefs were completely gone, even if your mood was still high or low?

No, the voices and beliefs have never gone away for a two-week period. They have been pretty constant and steady over most of this past year, even when my mood shifts from high and energetic to flat or low.

opening_question.question: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a chronic psychotic syndrome with prominent bizarre grandiose and persecutory delusions plus auditory hallucinations, and clear manic syndrome with decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, increased activity, pressured/overactive behavior, and irritability. Psychotic symptoms persisted for weeks to months outside mood episodes, and there was no sustained period of remission of psychosis. This best fits schizoaffective disorder, manic type.
